summary: Repair the unaccepted SP-02 migration SQL so a fresh database can apply the canonical procurement operations migration before SP-02 is formally closed.
protectedReason: The current safety gate treats every existing migration as accepted historical state. SP-02 is merged but not formally CLOSED/ACCEPTED and its migration has not passed an execution gate. This change adds a narrow, explicit bugfix-only mechanism for repairing a specifically declared unaccepted migration without permitting deletion, rename, or blanket historical migration edits.
unacceptedMigrationRepairReason: SP-02 is not formally accepted. The migration contains invalid statement ordering and a duplicate CREATE TABLE, so it must be canonicalized before acceptance; no accepted historical migration is being changed.

historicalMigrationIdentifierRepairs.reason: Fresh PostgreSQL execution proves two accepted AC-12 index identifiers truncate to the same 63-byte PostgreSQL name. Repair is identifier-only: indexed columns, uniqueness, ordering, and schema semantics remain unchanged.
